$npc.npc_marek.name: Marek
$npc.npc_marek.line_1: Bring me what the stone beasts leave behind. Scrap will not bite on what comes out of this wood.
$npc.npc_marek.line_2: My anvil was a tree once. Everything here was something once.
$npc.npc_sella.name: Sella
$npc.npc_sella.line_1: Last stall before the stone. Buy what you need: nothing grows past here.
$npc.npc_sella.line_2: I sell to anyone who walks out again. So far that is a short list.
$npc.npc_oswin.name: Oswin
$npc.npc_oswin.line_1: Keep to the causeway. What steps off it, the marsh keeps.
$npc.npc_oswin.line_2: They ring a bell out there at night. Nobody is left to ring it.
$npc.npc_ketta.name: Ketta
$npc.npc_ketta.line_1: Flasks, mostly. People drink fast out here.
$npc.npc_ketta.line_2: The clans do not trade. They forge, and then they come down the road.

$npc.npc_corwen.qst_stone_in_the_wood: The tower is quiet, and still the shards grow. Past the Gate, north-west, there is a wood where nothing moves: the trees are stone, and so are the wolves that hunt in it. Start with the wolves.
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_the_drowned_village: Beyond the Stonewood the ground gives way to water. There was a village there, with a king of its own. The marsh took both, and neither has stayed down.
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_clans_of_the_fire: Past the marsh the land burns. The orc clans that the fire did not kill have made it their forge, and their warlord wears it. That is where the shards are being fed from.

$npc.npc_brann.line_1: Nothing fancy. Good iron, honest leather, and it fits.
$npc.npc_brann.line_2: The fine pieces come off the dead out there. What you start in comes from me.
$npc.npc_brann.name: Brann
$npc.npc_corwen.line_1: The Hollow was a kiln-town once. We fired the stone that built the Gate.
$npc.npc_corwen.line_2: The shards started glowing the year the kilns went cold. Nobody here thinks that is a coincidence.
$npc.npc_corwen.line_3: Break every shard you find. They grow back, but slower each time — or so I tell myself.
$npc.npc_corwen.name: Corwen
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_breakers_at_the_gate: Up at the Gate the snow does not keep the dead down. Skeletons walk the pass, and something at the door of the Demon Tower is raising them. Put twelve back where they belong.
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_into_the_catacombs: Past the Gate stands the Demon Tower, nine floors of it. Whatever is feeding the shards sits on its throne at the top. Rest at the shrines on the way up.
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_reeds_in_the_hollow: The field rats have crept right up to the wall. Thin them out before they get into the stores — east and south of the gate.
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_the_gnawing_barrows: Orcs have come down into the Vale Floor and made it a war camp. Their grunts are everywhere on the road. Twelve of them, and they will think twice about the rest of it.
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_thornbacks_on_the_ro: The village past the Approach burned a month ago, and raiders in painted masks still pick over its ruins. Thin them out — ten of them — and the road is ours again.
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_wolves_of_the_ridge: Past the valley the Ridge has gone to sand, and the spiders have it. Something big is breeding them in the rocks. The road to the Gate is closed until their numbers are down.
$npc.npc_hesk.line_1: Bring me iron and gan and I will make that blade worth carrying.
$npc.npc_hesk.line_2: A failed temper costs you the materials. Never the item. I do not break what people bring me.
$npc.npc_hesk.name: Hesk
$npc.npc_idra.line_1: Scrap, oil, stones, ink — always. The rest depends on what the carts bring.
$npc.npc_idra.line_2: I buy anything, at a price. Sold something by mistake? I keep it on the side for a while.
$npc.npc_idra.name: Idra
$npc.npc_tobin.line_1: Snow on the pass, coin in the pocket. What do you need?
$npc.npc_tobin.line_2: I go no further up. Whatever lives up there doesn't pay.
$npc.npc_tobin.name: Tobin
